author: Marlon Chaviano
name: mobile-ionic-angular
title: Mobile app with Ionic and Angular
description: Ionic with standalone Angular and Capacitor: apps for iOS, Android and the web from one codebase, with mobile components and native APIs.
setupTasks: Capacitor: to test on a device, add the platform (`npx cap add ios` or `npx cap add android`) and then `npx cap sync`.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Standalone Angular components with Ionic's (`IonContent`, `IonList`…) imported one by one from `@ionic/angular/standalone`.
- Native APIs are used through Capacitor plugins.
- After changing web code: `npm run build && npx cap sync`. Before finishing: `npm run build`.
